portfolio_accounting: six equal symbol sleeves, each initialized at 1/6 portfolio equity; at most one open trade per symbol; each sleeve compounds only its own closed trades; portfolio equity is the sum of sleeve equities
signal_collision: each symbol acts independently; no cross-symbol ranking after signal threshold
drawdown_measure: combined realized sleeve equity at every trade exit event
sharpe_measure: sqrt(365) times mean daily portfolio realized return divided by population std; zero-return days included
funding_and_costs: applied inside each symbol sleeve before compounding
note: addendum freezes accounting only; signal/candidates/gates remain unchanged from CRYPTO_QUARTER_HOUR_OFI_V1_FREEZE
